# My Interview Practice

> > AI-powered interview preparation platform offering mock interviews, behavioral question coaching using the STAR method, and role-specific practice for students and professionals.

My Interview Practice provides an Interview Simulator with AI-powered feedback to help candidates prepare for behavioral, technical, and industry-specific interviews. The platform partners with educational institutions, career development organizations, and workforce programs to deliver accessible interview coaching.

## Key Topics

- STAR method
- Interview Simulator
- AI-powered feedback
- Behavioral interview questions
- Mock interviews
- Technical interview preparation
- Career development
- Virtual interviews
- Conflict resolution
- Communication skills
- Student interview prep
- Industry-specific questions
- Partnership platform
- Interview simulation
- Workplace scenarios

## Platform & Pricing

- [Affordable Interview Practice Plans](https://myinterviewpractice.com/pricing): Pricing plans for My Interview Practice AI simulator and premium features

## Behavioral Interview Guides

- [How Do You Handle Conflict - Interview Questions Guide](https://myinterviewpractice.com/blog/conflict): Guide to answering behavioral interview questions about workplace conflict
- [How to Answer Interview Questions About Failure](https://myinterviewpractice.com/blog/failure): STAR format guide for answering behavioral questions about failure
- [Common Interview Questions About Ethics](https://myinterviewpractice.com/blog/ethics): STAR format guide for behavioral questions about workplace ethics

## Technical & General Interview Prep

- [How to Handle Technical Interview Questions](https://myinterviewpractice.com/article/technical-questions): Guide to technical interview questions with problem-solving strategies
- [Top Virtual Interview Tips to Ace Your Next Job Interview](https://myinterviewpractice.com/blog/how-to-prepare-for-a-virtual-interview-7-key-tips): Virtual interview tips for Zoom and remote job interviews post-COVID-19
- [Common Interview Questions and Answers for Students](https://myinterviewpractice.com/blog/mock-interview-questions-and-answers-for-students): Entry-level interview prep guide for students seeking first jobs

## Industry-Specific Interview Questions

- [Top 24 Medical School Admissions Interview Questions [2025]](https://myinterviewpractice.com/industries-details/school-admissions/medical-school-admissions-interview-preparation): Interview prep guide for medical school admissions process
- [Top 24 Structural Engineer Interview Questions [2025]](https://myinterviewpractice.com/industries-details/architecture/structural-engineer-interview-preparation): Technical interview questions and prep for structural engineering roles
- [Top 28 Sales Associate Interview Questions [2025]](https://myinterviewpractice.com/industries-details/marketing-and-advertising/sales-associate-interview-questions): Retail sales associate interview prep with customer service techniques
- [Top 22 Public Relations Officer Interview Questions [2025]](https://myinterviewpractice.com/industries-details/marketing-and-advertising/public-relations-officer-interview-preparation): PR officer interview prep covering media relations and campaign metrics
- [Top 24 Assessor Interview Questions [2025]](https://myinterviewpractice.com/industries-details/government/assessor-interview-preparation): Interview prep guide for assessor positions in government/property valuation
